shortDescription: Brazilian digital lender Nubank NYSE:NU said on Friday it has halted cryptocurrency withdrawals and deposits temporarily due to disruptions from an unnamed external data provider.

children: said on Friday it has halted cryptocurrency withdrawals and deposits temporarily due to disruptions from an unnamed external data provider.
Nubank said the problem is not related to its own infrastructure and does not compromise customer security
All assets and information remain protected, the firm said
Operations will be resumed as soon as the service is restored, it added
